primary_claims_for_peer_review: 135 – 803 B) that carry no strings. What it services is `FZ-18` — *answered 2026-09-13:* `003BB790` is the **save-storage command machine**. Its seven handlers call a small PC storage layer at `00862xxx` that keeps a result word at `02EAF8E0` and a file handle at `02EAF8E8` and is built on the CRT file calls (`008621E0` formats a wide path and opens, seeks, tells and closes through the `008C2Exx` imports; `008625D0` closes the handle; `00862490` reports a fixed card type `0x2000000` and a formatted flag 1) — a re-implementation of a PS2 memory-card-style interface over files. `003BAEB0` also consults `SaveWrite_GetBusyFlag` (`00583920`). The machine runs only while the byte **`02AD9E00`** is non-zero (getter `0036FD50`; this page and the ledger had cited `02ADA000`, which nothing references). The byte is set to 1 by `0036FD80` from `SaveWrite_PrepareAndSubmitFullImage` (`0057E479`), `SaveStorageQueue_ControllerStateHandler` (`0058242C`), `00393EA0` and `00252030`, set to 0 by the same setter at `0057E591`, and cleared by `0036FD70` (boot `0022A3E3`, `00252030`, `00393EA0`, `005823ED`, the thunk `0050C980`) and `0036FD60` (via `00379D40`). What each of the ten substates does is not decoded.
